reviews.title: Actual flight OK - the rest, a total shambles
reviews.text: Have flown with KLM for many years. On this occasion I was shocked by the appalling check in experience and incompetent member of staff. I checked in online and boarding cards were not available - told had to check in at the airport to get boarding passes. I assumed that this was just a system glitch. On line chat was completely useless and I telephoned to try and get the issue sorted (hand luggage only). After holding for over an hour, I spoke to someone who told me that check-in would be open 3 hours before the flight departure time. Also told me that the check-in opened at 13.05 (flight was due to depart at 13.30). Left with no option but to check in at the airport, we discovered that check-in opened 2.5 hours before departure. We then had the great misfortune to be dealt with by a member of staff who insisted that we had to check in backpacks. Advised her that we were carrying medical monitoring equipment, medication and laptop. She said that we should put all such things in one backpack and that we could take one on board. I said that the bags were not suitable for the hold, they have straps and do not lock. She said that many people did not lock bags and that they could go via large luggage section. (Bags meet hand luggage requirements for KLM and were half the allowed weight). Asked her how much to upgrade so that we could take both bags on board. She said £169!! Eventually she deigned to refer to her supervisor. Supervisor looked at the bags and said, without hesitation that they were fine to be taken on board as hand luggage. Agent did not even apologise. We proceeded through security. Flight was then delayed by what turned out to be two hours. Actual flight was fine, but we will never fly KLM again.
reviews.author: JJEnglandUK

reviews.title: Terrible experience in difficult times
reviews.text: I booked the ticket from Toronto to India but currently cause there is no Visa services from Canada to India I requested to have a refund my ticket. I booked my ticket to the app and I canceled and requested a refund to the app as well. I totally understand that the ticket was non-refundable. But just cause it was not voluntary reqiest and I have to cancel cause of visa service, I really thought KLM would understand the situation. Its a lot of money to go see family back home but not to KLM It's very upsetting cause my grandfather passed away. And I cannot even go visit my family. So KLM is not being there for its clients. I was comfortable to get us credit and not get money back so I can I travel with them still when the services resume from Canada to India but they did not do that either.. and the reason being cause I requested refund through app. If i can boom a ticket through app, why ai cannot request refund through app. It should be the same procedure. The customer care representative told me I should have called them first... they don't realize its a tough time for my family and i just lost my grandfather. So very heartless response .they don't appreciate the value of the customers or the emotions behind and the urgent situations that we have. It's really upsetting.
reviews.author: Manpreet S

reviews.title: Shrinkflation of the Skies
reviews.text: There is a theme running through KLM which is mean and underhand. Here’s how they work; - prices offered are reasonably competitive. Coupled with a historically good reputation and some good inflight staff this gets you buying a ticket. Then the Shrinkflation starts…. - the ticket price doesn’t include anything. Seat reservations (even for families), baggage - even on transatlantic. The additional fees are steep and represent a significant chunk of the final cost. - cheap on food a drinks. A miserliness has crept into the onboard service. I was offered one drink (beer or wine) on a transatlantic flight and they only serve one at a time. 1 drink in 7 hours? Don’t worry, it will be a small one too. As will the food. - seat pitch is at the edge of acceptability. A surprise for the tallest nation on earth but like most things klm is smaller than it should be. - expect micro-aggressions. Don’t know about you but I’ve always split my weight across bags. Nothing crazy but the odd bag over 22kg (say 25) but others at 17. KLM make you go through the indignity of re-packing. Don’t know why? They do a 32kg bag for some customers so it’s not a health and safety issue. Sadly really as they let down their very good staff with poor policy.
reviews.author: WalkersFox

reviews.title: First time ..won't be last
reviews.text: I used this airline from Switzerland to Amsterdam for the first time. I was totally impressed by this airline. Friendly staff; no hassle for exact bag weight; onboard service was also excellent. All went well. No lost luggage or damage at a time when many other passengers on other airlines were reporting lost luggage. I am impressed with this airline and will definitely reuse.
reviews.author: Coryy20

reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text: I have traveled from Rio to Amsterdam on a KLM flight on the 28th of July. I have booked this particular flight and adjusted my holiday to be able to fly in a 787-9 aircraft with a 1-2-1 set up and direct access to aisle as this was a night flight and I was traveling back alone. KLM change the aircraft and did not send any communication about this ( I wasn’t even to told at check-in) and I ended up travelling in an outdated aircraft with no access to the aisle. I have paid extra 300£ when booking the flight to be able to choose my seat as I wanted to make sure I have access to the aisle on this flight for personal reasons. If I would have known I could have asked for adjustments or even changed the flight for a different day, but I was not given this opportunity. I have sent a complaint to customer service only to be told this is not a genuine complaint and seats are not guaranteed apparently, even if you pay for it - newly introduced option to charge passengers more as previously on KLM business you could have picked seat without charge. I will not fly again KLM, there is no point making a financial effort and pay for business class to receive subomptimal service and be charged for things that are not delivered. This is particularly disappointing as I previously had good experiences with this airline but I looks like things have changed and not for the best.
reviews.author: Roxanna ☀️

reviews.title: KLM Customer Service is NON-Existent and they don’t care!
reviews.text: Flew for a 22 day vacation from the US to Ireland. Last leg AMS-DUB the pilot comes over the PA just before we land to inform us that they left most of the bags for the passengers in Amsterdam “due to a baggage system issue”. Promises they will be on the next flight. I counted six bags come off the airplane. Did no one from KLM question a full plane of passengers only having six bags? We left on time so it wasn’t like anyone called to check on it. There was even a group of about twenty kids headed to summer camp and none us us received our luggage. Over six days it took for them to “find” our luggage! Two more days to get it to us. In the interim you get alleged customer service agents from all over the world that direct you back to a web site tracker that doesn’t work. None of them have a supervisor and none of them are willing to escalate. To top it out when using social media to try and get in touch with someone, we were almost scammed into giving our banking information. They have serious issue at AMS with luggage, it is well documented. I even e-mailed the CEO with no response because apparently they DON’T CARE! Because my flight was booked initially with Delta I have no booking reference number so I cannot even begin to process my over $720 reimbursement request. Trying to get that reference number is equally difficult as the customer service representatives are incompetent. STAY AWAY FROM KLM YOU ARE BETTER OFF WITH ANY OTHER AIRLINE!
reviews.author: Batt2

reviews.title: Lost Luggage - the story of KLM
reviews.text: KLM need to realise the time they allocate for transfers between some of their flights do not permit the luggage to arrive on time. Which must cost them more in the long run in all the claims for delayed luggage Our luggage didn't make our flight arriving in Rome sunday afternoon. missed our hotel taxi as so long reporting it missing. Didn't arrive until 8pm on Monday Had a claim in for expenses for 3 weeks now and no one can update on how it is progressing Terrible service
reviews.author: Colette H

reviews.title: KLM Holidays
reviews.text: What a scam is KLM holidays. I booked because I had good experience with flying KLM. But by booking with KLM it turned out I am not a customer of KLM, I do not fly KLM. Booking process is horrible, until very late in the process it is not clear you are not flying with KLM but with a partner. During the booking you cannot opt for a ticket incl luggage. The partner luggage amounts are not mentioned anywhere. After booking I could book the baggage with the partner for 120 euros per suitcase!!! So an extra amount of € 240 for me and my kid on a not cheap ticket. What a scam!!!! Plus as an extra KLM send me a marketing email 3 days(!!) after I booked with a € 350 discount on package holidays (that was really a nice way of saying we screwed you ;-)) NEVER AGAIN
reviews.author: Nico

reviews.title: Great!!
reviews.text: Flight was on time, food was good and we were fed often, big screens, lots of entertainment and comfortable chair! And everyone was so nice! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Amanda B

reviews.title: Incompetent Staff
reviews.text: I have been at the front of the line to check in/bag drop. In over an hour only 3 people have been checked in. Never again.
reviews.author: Michel A

reviews.title: Terrible airlines
reviews.text: It can said that KLM airlines are the worst airlines ever. We had a conference on 25th and they gave us a new ticket at 26th. Cancelled my flight in last few hours, gave me no choice except flying in 26th which i can already see alternative flights on skyscanner app. The customer service just hang on on the phone at 18:00 o clock, and you can not call back them. I don’t know what to do. I can say everyone who reads this that never choose to fly with KLM.
reviews.author: Efe D

reviews.title: Fight delayed
reviews.text: One expects of the Royal Dutch Airlines to deliver a service for a given price. KLM has left the path of reliability in it's quest to follow costcutters like Ryanair and the like.... .. resulting in top heavy schedules with a lot if strain on pilots and cabine personnel... resulting on delays....of more than 1.5 hrs on straightforward flights like this. The pilot himself said "this flights is running bevind schedule all day' That, dear customer , is man made. Therefore, based on my objective experience today, life in the airplane, I do not recommend you to fly KLM. Thé air carrier is de unreliable.
reviews.author: Ber A

reviews.title: You might get to your destiny (in case the airplane is there) - but don't expect service and especially no refunds
reviews.text: The first flight from Seattle to Amsterdam worked just fine. The connection flight from Amsterdam to Frankfurt was delayed more than 8 hours. After many many phone calls (and a phone hotline that aims at directing you towards the website and hanging up on you), we managed to make clear, that we will take the train to Frankfurt instead (imagine relying on a german train instead of the airline). Well the refund for the connection flight has now been granted (after a month instead of 7 days)- but the refund is nowhere near the correct refund. Instead, all KLM refunded was 20 Euros and some change (only the fees were refunded). The porblem now is, how do you get a hold of someone to talk to? You simply don't. Really a big disappointment when it comes to customer service, customer journey and just the overall impression is extremly bad. This service offer simply sucks!
reviews.author: db27062021

reviews.title: Good inflight experience
reviews.text: Flights from Boston on an A330-300 via Amsterdam to Edinburgh on a 737-800. World business class is comfortable, on this plane 2-2-2 seating configuration that is not popular because if you have a window seat you have to climb over your seat mate if their seat is extended. Flying time was 6 hours 30 minutes so not really long enough to sleep more than a few hours. Meals served were adequate but nothing special. Cabin crew were welcoming, helpful and attentive as is usually the case with KLM. On this occasion the flight was delayed by an hour due to the late arrival of the aircraft caused by rain and storms in Amsterdam but that is not KLM's fault. The flight from Amsterdam to Edinburgh was spot on time.
reviews.author: Dawn A

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Horrible experience: 4 failed booking, 4 issues bad vouchers more than 10 times bad customer service. Never had a good experience with KLM
reviews.author: M O

reviews.title: Doing frauds with customers don't buy tickets for this airlines
reviews.text: They sell you cheap tickets before 2-3 months if you buy tickets from them and after that when you go on your travel date than they first board the pessengers who had purchased expensive tickets for the same destinations of the customers who gave them more money to travel, and also they harras you saying you have fake travel documents etc so that their fault of overbooking of flight could be hidden and they will allegedly fraudulently make you believe that you're not allowed to board. But then i booked the emirates flight on the same day to travel they didn't said even a word about anything because their flight was not overbooked, beware of KLM its a fraud flight company don't buy their tickets. Buying tickets from KLM 1. Loose your money 2. Loose your respect 3. Spoil your tour 4. Get harrasment for the refund which they never process 5. They don't even give you any support either Although it was a direct ticket purchased from the KLM website still the problems presists with them to me also in the one email when they were not able to say anything they said your ticket was forged. In this case they are proving that they sell fake tickets to the customers, its all a robbery of the hard earned money of the customers. Still if you have any self respect don't even buy their tickets. And help the passengers to avoid such fraud airline so their revenue could drop and they will start respecting their customers. Thanks and regards
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.title: KLM did not refund me, but they keep saying they did transfer, is been 90 DAYS!
reviews.text: KLM has not refunded my money yet, it has been over 90 days since I've been waiting for my refund payment. I have contacted them multiple times, and each time they ask me to be patient. How much patience does a customer have to have? They said they would pay me and provided me with numbers that even my bank couldn't locate. It's absurd, the worst customer service I have ever experienced. I will never fly with KLM again because when they want something from customers, they are very helpful, but when it comes to returning the customer's money, we are told to be patient. I have been waiting for over 90 days, and I have no idea when or if I will receive my refund. This is the worst customer service I have ever encountered in my life.
reviews.author: Caroline M

reviews.title: NEVER FLY KLM
reviews.text: I assure you to NOT fly KLM! They delayed the flight for 2 hours once we were sitting on the plane for no apparent reason. One was they were fueling and the other was a technical reason that go resolved in 5 minutes… not sure how trustworthy that is. Then I missed my connection because of this delay and when I asked the flight attendant what would happen, it didn’t even phase him that that connection could’ve actually been very important for people and he said “it’s fine we’ll just send you a new boarding pass” like they do this often. Then they book me on a different airline and my baggage gets lost and it’s now been 4 days of me traveling Europe with NO BAG! And KLM keeps trying to put it on the other airline, however that airline looked through all their bags and said that KLM has it. There is no urgency or care for their customers and I am expecting a great reimbursement of all the new clothes I’ve had to buy, toiletries, and new baggage. Not to mention my time. I have never been this frustrated with an airline in my life and I am a huge traveler. Please do not give your money to KLM.
reviews.author: Jillian M

reviews.title: Worst airline ever experienced. Complete disaster.
reviews.text: KLM airlines provided an abysmal travel experience that left me utterly disappointed. From the moment I stepped onto the plane, the problems began. The seats were cramped and uncomfortable, offering minimal legroom for even an average-sized person. The in-flight entertainment system was outdated, with a limited selection of movies and frequent glitches. The food served was tasteless and unappetizing, resembling something you would find in a low-quality cafeteria. To make matters worse, the flight attendants were rude and inattentive, showing no regard for passenger comfort or needs. The overall lack of professionalism and subpar service makes me vow to never fly with KLM again.
reviews.author: Naziya

reviews.title: Put delicate cabin luggage as check-in and completely damage expensive baggage worth thousands of EUROS
reviews.text: Worst airline ever: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines. They will forcefully put your small Louis Vuitton cabin luggage into check-in saying the flight is full but when you enter the flight there is ample space to put your luggage. By the way, they were so rude and didn’t give us time to think or to rearrange things from cabin luggage (like medicines). Compartments were empty. Also they ensure to completely damage the expensive baggage. When approached customer service during our layover in Amsterdam to claim the baggage as we had our medication in the baggage, they had unhelpful replies as they love saying NO. The lady at transfer desk didn’t even try once to figure out our luggage location and to assist us in anyways but clearly said NO WE CANT DO ANYTHING. NEVER EVER FLY WITH THIS AIRLINE IF YOU WANT WANT TO FLY PEACEFULLY & COMFORTABLY.
reviews.author: Dipti

reviews.title: 4 hours of delay without compensation and information
reviews.text: I had a flight Madrid to Seattle with a stop at Amsterdam the 14th May. When arriving at Amsterdam, the flight had 4 hours of delay. No information was given. When asking after the flight for compensation and reason of delay, they only indicated that they could not provide any compensation despite the 4 hours delay.
reviews.author: Martin B

reviews.title: Worst airlines, worst then AirIndia
reviews.text: KLM airlines is a complete disaster. From the moment I stepped foot on their plane, I knew I was in for a terrible experience. The seats were cramped and uncomfortable, with no legroom whatsoever. The in-flight entertainment system was a joke, with outdated movies and glitchy screens. The flight attendants were rude and inattentive, providing minimal assistance to passengers. The food served was tasteless and unappetizing, with limited options for those with dietary restrictions. To top it all off, my luggage was lost during the journey and the customer service was abysmal, showing no urgency or care in locating it. I would never fly with KLM again.
reviews.author: Naziya

reviews.title: Great flight from Rome to Amsterdam. Thank You!
reviews.text: We flew from Rome to Amsterdam on a Monday to spend a week in the Netherlands. What a great beginning to our stay! Our bursar was wonderful, always pleasant and ready to smile. Thoroughly professional and cordial. He made our flight perfect. Thank you!
reviews.author: RonL40

reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK WITH THIS AIRLINE!!!
reviews.text: Shocking service from start to finish - inability to check in, no boarding passes and at the airport they had 4 staff members unable to check passengers in due to not having log in details apparently! That's all before they had no ability to check luggage because the label machine ran out of paper! As a result we missed our flight & KLM couldn't care less! Complete opposite to our experience with Easy Jet when we were left with no alternative but to rebook flights at the airport.
reviews.author: Connor O

reviews.title: No refund
reviews.text: I purchased a flight online via KLM's official website to travel from London to Amsterdam for the May bank holiday. I booked and paid online, and KLM took the money straight away. Less than half an hour after booking online, a KLM representative called me to say that the flight I had booked onto was overbooked and they couldn't accommodate me that day. I was offered an alternative flight travelling out of London 2 WEEKS later. Naturally I didn't want this, and therefore requested a refund. You would have thought that this could naturally happen straight away - not so, it has now been over a month and my refund request has been rejected 3 times, despite the fact that they cancelled on me. Under European law I should also be eligible for compensation - this has also been denied. Customer service send auto-rejection emails in incoherent, badly written english from email addresses you cannot reply to as they don't accept incoming mail. Using their phone and Whatsapp accounts are a useless exercise - it is like communicating with a robot.
reviews.author: Zoe

reviews.title: Just not pleasant. Terrible
reviews.text: This was the first time I had flown on KLM, and I was really looking forward to it. Why? Because they fly the 787 from my home airport to Amsterdam. I had never flown on a 787, but wanted to check out the latest in commercial aviation comfort. Also, I was going to Europe for 3 weeks and was really excited! However, at the end of the trip, I found myself extremely disappointed with KLM. I don't think I will fly with them again. It started with the first flight, I remember boarding the plane at MSP, we were in economy comfort. It was quite warm in the cabin. We sat down, I looked over at my wife and said "Don't worry, it will cool down when we get in the air." The problem is... it didn't! It was hot in the cabin the entire 7 hour flight. I remember thinking, does KLM not believe in temperature control? If you are cold, that's what you gave the blankets for. However, when its that hot in the cabin, its just plain uncomfortable and nobody was using their blanket. After 3 wonderful weeks in Europe, it was time to go home. We had a KLM flight from Rome to Minneapolis with the connection in Amsterdam. Our KLM flight leaving Rome was 1 1/2 hours delayed resulting in us missing our connection. What made it worse was I had upgraded to business class for that flight. After missing our connection, we waited in line for 3 hours in some "transfer" line only to be greeted by KLM employees who were not helpful and love to give the runaround. They told all the passengers who had been waiting for 3 hours they needed to go to a different transfer line. We ended up waiting an additional 2 hours. Finally after reaching the front of the line, the KLM travel desk indicated they were going to put us on a flight to Atlanta with a 3 hour layover and then onto Minneapolis at midnight. They were also the worst seats possible and not even together. They also downgraded our class, so I lost my upgrade and told me I would have to request a refund at a later time. We looked at each other and were like "no," we are not flying to the other side of America, have a long layover, just to double back to Minneapolis after we have waited in line for 5 hours. We opted to take a flight the next day direct to Minneapolis on a Delta airlines flight. We asked the KLM agent several times to make it very clear. "Will our checked bags be on the Delta flight tomorrow?" The KLM agent assured us they would. Me and my wife got a hotel in Amsterdam on our own dime. The only upside was we explored a little bit of Amsterdam which is a beautiful city. We finally flew back to Minneapolis the following day on a Delta airlines flight. The flight was pleasant and comfortable. The cabin was not hot. We got to Minneapolis and found out that KLM had not put our baggage on the flight. We reported the issue with Delta who in turn were pleasant and addressed the issue. We had our baggage delivered the following day. In conclusion with my first time flight with KLM. 1. Cabin was super warm, uncomfortable and gives you a claustrophobic feeling. 2. KLM agents and employees were not helpful and would pretty much say "no" to anything and everything. You could have asked them if they were wearing blue and they would tell you no. 3. Delays and Missed connections followed by more waiting. 4. KLM did not put our baggage on our delta flight the following day, even though they assured us they would. I have never had such an unpleasant experience with any airline before. Sure I've encountered issues on flights and delays before. What separates KLM from those other airlines is KLM just didn't seem to care, nor did they have a process of dealing with missed connections at Amsterdam. The only answer I ever received from any KLM agent was "no." Didn't matter the questions, the answer was always "no."
reviews.author: Brandon B

reviews.title: The worst!
reviews.text: We will never fly KLM again. Our baggage was delayed and when we went to pick it up from the airport, it was damaged. They wouldn't compensate us even though we reported it online the next day because they need a "satisfactory report of damaged baggage". Who the hell has time for this when you just arrived to a new country and are awaiting rides. Last time we flew with KLM, same thing happened but we didn't know we could report. It's the worst airline. We had a better experience with easyJet and Lufthansa. They are negligent and won't compensate for their mistakes. I will never fly with them again.
reviews.author: Ana v

reviews.title: Never surrender carry on luggage
reviews.text: When you tell Scottish people that your luggage has been delayed, you know something is dreadfully wrong when they laugh and they’ve nicknamed the airline..Keeper of Luggage of Mine (KLM). I can understand when one luggage is delayed but when airline delay all 5 of our party luggage, it’s unacceptable for 50 hours especially when I called to informed the agent that it was vital that we have our luggage expedited because my brother in law had his diabetic and heart medication in his carry on. Also, I informed the KLM agent the exact whereabouts of our luggage as the airline kept sending messages to my brother-in-law that our luggage was in Aberdeen when in fact, our luggage were sitting at Amsterdam and then Edinburgh, Scotland. I told the agent that I had AirTags- our luggage did more sight-seeing than us, instead of flying the luggage, the airline decided to courier (driving) to Aberdeen (over 36 hours later) with multiple delivery stops. On good faith, we checked in our carry ons to the airline. Never again. KLM seats are thin - most uncomfortable for international travel; we paid extra for comfort economy. The connection between Amsterdam to Aberdeen - flight seats were comfortable and it’s economy class. Suggestion for KLM: listen to your passengers. Technology such as Air Tags are becoming a norm for travellers, do not lie to us. Positive outcome: we received our money for purchasing essentials in a timely manner.
reviews.author: mjappy

reviews.title: Heavily heavily disappointed.
reviews.text: Do not recommend flying with KLM anymore after this horrid experience. Worst flight I have had in years! First of all flight was delayed for 2 hours because they had not checked the sanitary facilities while everyone was still waiting at the gate. Only until everyone took their seat they decided to send a mechanical team to "fix" the lavatories and had everyone delayed for almost 2 hours. The only thing they fixed was putting a tape over the sink so nobody could wash their hands the entire 12 hour flight. Here's some other things to mention; - Captain was inexperienced and unprofessional and him and his crew were impossible to understand in all languages (NL/ENG/SPA). Besides that he flew and parked bad resulting in more delay and docking erroneously. - Airplane was disgusting, smudges, stains, and filth everywhere on the seats in front, the ceilings, the windows, old junk, clearly has not been cleaned thoroughly in months. - Airplane temperature was way too high, there was no personal airco or ventilation available, so the whole plane was kept at 26 degrees and every request to lower it ignored. - Entertainment System did not work at all for a big part of the passengers, for the ones it did work it was repeatedly shut off in order to reset, or for the captain to come with another useless and uninterpretable message. Watching a movie without it being stopped at least 6 times was impossible. - Crew was not friendly, while we actually had the nicest stewardess in our isle, we witnessed the other crew members being demeaning and condescending to fellow passengers. - no leg space at all. I could go on and on but you probably get the jist: Paying top prize for a flight with a "world-class airline" and being treated like you're booking the most cheap budget airline is unacceptable! Very very very disappointed and will never fly to Mexico using KLM again. Please use AeroMexico if you're thinking to make the same trip.
reviews.author: Valentijn G

reviews.title: Look, I know this is economy but wow...
reviews.text: The seats were uncomfortable but that's not the star of the show here. The food from Accra to Amsterdam was so disgusting. I don't know what catering service you used but PLEASE change them. They are not doing you any favours. I still remember the taste of that "food" and I literally gag. Soggy, unseasoned spinach in palm oil, undercooked watery rice and half-spoiled coleslaw. Dessert is usually the redeemer of any meal but whatever this brick was couldn't save it. It's economy, I get it. But please, even just a slice of bread and butter would've been better than this.
reviews.author: Gia

reviews.title: worst experience ever
reviews.text: I was flying solo from Toronto to Dubai and had a layover in Amsterdam for 3 hours. At the boarding gate, I was asked to present my visa to Dubai. Apparently they had to email this UAE Immigration for verification and this is 15 minutes before gates close. Imagine, you have to be approved to fly back home, even after being a resident for 20 years and having a valid residence visa. I was not allowed to board the flight because the approval didn't come on time. Instead, was asked to board the next flight which was next day same time. A teenager who has never lived alone in her life is now stranded on an airport in a new country. It gets worse from here. At the transfer desk, a rude lady told me that I will not be provided with hotel or food as compensation so she suggested that I could sleep on one of the chairs at the airport for the next 24hrs. Without a Schengen visa to exit, I was trapped in the airport confused, hungry and jetlagged. Finally, my family helped me get a room in a small hotel within the airport which was obviously not cheap, only to find out that the new ticket given doesn't have the correct name. So I had to go back to get a new one and wait in line for another hour. Please, pay a little more and go by another airlines. Its not worth the reduced cost to deal with so much trauma. I was helpless, hungry, jetlagged and was crying to come home to be with my family. So just don't ever put your family through this miserly for a few more Euros.
reviews.author: Celeste F

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER
reviews.text: I bought a retunr ticket from Amsterdam to Madrid and paid for both flights almost 200 euros, no one gave me any flight for free. Because of an emergency I decided to go to Spain before, so I bought another flight. My surprise was that when I was trying to do the check in for the flight back, KLM told me I could not take it because I did not take the first one and they told me that in order to let me get into the plane I had to pay a fee of 120. Can you imaging my frustuation?? Since I live in Amsterdam KML and transavia are 2 companies that are a nightmare! The last one is that the agent that it was really polite, told me that next time I have to call to CService to tell them in advance that im not going to take the flight, What? Such a customer experience, also advice me to buy 2 different tickets, making me work DOUBLE! I would have liked they advice or warn me in advance. This is one example of typical company good at SALES but bad at CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.author: Isabel G

reviews.title: Poorly staffed check-in service
reviews.text: Not enough staffed check-in desks meant that we had to wait over an hour in the queue to check-in our luggage. We have travelled recently with both Jet2 and Easyjet and the process was swift and efficient because there were multiple check-in desks. KLM had two check-in desks but one was for business class and those with special needs or priorities - that's fine but to leave those non-priority customers (the vast majority) with one check in until the other had dealt with all the priority cases, was poor service. Why can't a long-established, prestigious, national airline offer a service which is at least as good as some budget airlines?
reviews.author: lizglasgow2018

reviews.title: Worth travel ever
reviews.text: The worst company for transporting people. We booked one-way tickets in advance to their vaunted premium comfort class, tickets cost ~30,000 SEK. And nothing foreshadowed trouble until we randomly checked our tickets 14 days before the trip, which indicated that we were downgraded because this flight does not have premium comfort seats (then why sell them if you do not have seats???) we talked with managers for 10 days, each of whom gave different information, starting from the fact that such tickets were never sold on this plane and after presenting evidence, they simply threw the phone or transferred to an office located in South America, or said that we could not help in any way, write to the support service after arrival (we did done) . The flight was extremely uncomfortable, in fact, we sat on a stool for 9 hours as a family was sitting behind with a child in their arms who calmed him all the time, who was more than 7 years old, and the cold was on the plane as if they were in a T-shirt in February on the streets of Stockholm. After arrival, we applied for a refund, the website states that if your trip is longer than 3000km outside of Europe, then you are guaranteed to get 75% of the price paid. We submitted an application where we indicated that we want to get a refund TO a BANK CARD, not a voucher, not yet a bonus, namely TO a BANK CARD, a week of silence and then bingo, a voucher of 440 Euros with a validity of 12 months (for two) comes, which is not something that is 75%, but even 15% ate ate, to which we write a request to the klm back that we need money and not a voucher that we will not use because firstly we did not ask for it and secondly we do not plan to go anywhere in the next few years with the help of their company. To which we receive a response from the manager - Thank you for your answer, but we can't help you with anything since you have already been given a voucher, and you can't get the money. and now the question is, how can I want to use your company after that if after the flight there were only negative emotions in addition with a cold neck that needs to be treated and with bronchitis in my wife?
reviews.author: Nazar

reviews.title: absolutely atrocious service
reviews.text: This is not the first time I've travelled with them but this most recent experience was absolutely atrocious. My original flight from Milan to Singapore (KL1632, KL835) was cancelled 4 days before my flight because they apparently needed to fix the plane (don't really doubt this, would also not want to fly on a damaged plane) and they mentioned they successfully rebooked me on an Emirates flight a day before my original flight date. Less than 30 hours before my flight, I was trying to check in online and faced some issues so I contacted KLM via WhatsApp only for them to inform me that I was not rebooked at all. They rebooked me on an AirFrance flight, and when I tried to check in online for that, I faced some issues again. Worried that I was not rebooked again, I contacted Air France and confirmed with them that I was booked on it and they confirmed that I was and that I should just check in at the airport. Just to confirm that I have a seat on it, I even bought a seat for the long second leg of my flight from Paris to Singapore (13 hours) just to make sure I will be comfortable. Less than 12 hours before my AirFrance flight, KLM contacted me once again to tell me I was not successfully rebooked and they proposed another alternative flight instead. At that point, the whole rebooking nightmare was absolutely atrocious so I rebooked a completely different flight with Qatar Airways less than 10 hours before that flight left Milan and had no trouble checking in online. The KLM "My Info" showed me I could not even get a refund for the seat that I paid for on a flight that I wasn't even on, which is simply atrocious and I was furious. In conclusion - if they cancel your flight, you're better off requesting for that refund and rebooking another airline. Chances are they can never guarantee your rebooking so don't even bother. I've been trying to request for compensation but they don't even allow me to input my booking details anymore and keep saying my booking code is invalid. I'm trying to find a way to email them directly but don't think there's any hope. So if you can, just don't bother with this airline.
reviews.author: danielle

reviews.title: Unreliable Carrier, Appalling  Customer Service, Do NOT travel on this Carrier on Business
reviews.text: On May 29, I travelled on my KLM booked return flight from SFO via CDG to Johannesburg on AF085 connecting to AF990. My flight was booked at least 6 months before the trip. While in flight from SFO to Paris I received a message on the KLM that my connecting flight had been cancelled (QC4SC8). Upon arrival at CDG, despite being a Skyteam Elite Member (Delta Diamond, Million Miler), Air France/KLM staff were unhelpful. My flight was delayed over 4 hours yet they refused to re-book me on another carrier, nor refund my ticket. Staff kept looking for someone else to blame. Now Customer Care are declining my delayed compensation despite the flight being delayed for over 3 hours. I am scheduled to fly Business Class on AF/KLM next week (SWBOTD) but will cancel my flight and all future bookings (4K6RY4). This carrier is undependable, unreliable and customer service is arrogant. This carrier is undeserving of its customers’ patronage. Shame on you KLM/Air France!
reviews.author: Ken o

reviews.title: Never check in with them
reviews.text: We flight from Bilbao to Berlin via Amsterdam, basically they force us to check in our hand luggage... I ask the KLM worker if there won't be any problem with our luggage because 5 days ago my best friend and his husband make the same route and they lost it... She told me "it shouldn't be any problem, it will arrive in Berlin"... Basically it didn't... We don't have our luggage, and we also met another guy at the airport with the same route and lost luggage... I think it is just a pattern, they loose the luggage by routine... And of course they lie.... I wouldn't recommend check in the luggage with them...
reviews.author: Iciar Gomez

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Our flight was changed last minute with no notice majorly impacting wedding arrangements - with no empathy shown by the KLM team and a failure to address the problems by any member of your team.
reviews.author: Anthony154

reviews.title: Excellent Disability Assistance
reviews.text: Most of our trip consisted of flights by British Airways through Heathrow, all horrible experiences, particularly with disability assistance. Our flights with KLM in and out of Amsterdam could not have been more different. At Amsterdam, our flight attendant escorted us to the back of the plane, where a strange vehicle with extendable "legs" was docked. We got on, and the vehicle pulled away, lowered down to ground level, and carried us to a docking station at the airport. An employee transferred me to a small cart and maneuvered to the terminal. There I was met by a very friendly person with a wheelchair, who took me to the toilets and left me at a restaurant with the wheelchair, at my husband's request. All this extra service was performed by a string of people who made us believe that serving disabled passengers was the best part of their job. The contrast between this and our experiences in London shows how important it is for disabled people to be careful about their choice of airline and airport.
reviews.author: Susan L

reviews.title: No food at all if not specifically selected. Will never fly in KLM.
reviews.text: They don't give any food to the passengers unless you have selected a meal. My parents had to travel with no food 10 hrs. They don't give water either unless asked. No in-flight drinks/coffee either. The flight attendants don't walk around the flights either to ask for anything.
reviews.author: Vinata H

reviews.title: Terrible and garbage experience
reviews.text: Our KLM flight was delayed by 5 hours. That is a lot! This means we missed our connecting flight to Detroit from Amsterdam which is why KLM put us in a new flight. KLM handles checked bags poorly; bags are damaged along with items inside the bags. Customer service is bad; In New Delhi, lines are very long which took hours for me to get the boarding pass. Our boarding pass was given when we were moved to a new flight after the delays are announced. Bag tracking service is not good. Would never fly KLM again in my life!
reviews.author: super star

reviews.title: 1st time using them and will never fly KLM again
reviews.text: Booked a flight from Glasgow to Iquitos Peru with connecting flights in Amsterdam and Lima. The layover in Amsterdam was supposed to be 1hr 15 mins which after 2 phone calls and 2 Web chats they assured me was plenty of time to transfer my checked luggage from one plane to another. However the flight from Glasgow was delayed by 40 minutes because they had to remove one suitcase from the hold as the passenger didn't show up. This mean taking out all the luggage and putting it back in again. I finally get to Amsterdam in the nick of time and have to run to the departure gate for the flight to Lima. When I got to the gate I told the woman behind the desk I was just off the delayed Glasgow flight and asked her if there was enough time to transfer my checked luggage. She scanned a barcode sticker on my passport and said yes! So I get on the flight to Lima, 12 hours go by and we land. Got to the baggage reclaim and guess what?.... no luggage. My bag was still in Amsterdam. What shocks me even more is the way the air hostess on the flight from Glasgow giggled like a school girl saying initially she had no idea what caused the delay. They she said it was simply to remove 1 persons suitcase. This caused missed connections for people flying to Paris. Oslo and Munich as well as causing me to end up on the other side of the planet without my necessities. I won't ever be flying with KLM again. This is unacceptable.
reviews.author: Kay

reviews.title: Unsympathetic staff
reviews.text: On the 31st of May me and my fiancé WERE meant to be landing in Zagreb, Croatia. However this was changed drastically due to KLMs lack of organisation skills. To start with, the app to access our boarding pass failed, and we spent hours waiting for the app to reboot and gain our passes back. We then hit a 20 minute delay which wasnt shocking, but we later learned the flight would take longer because they had to wait for the air space to clear. This is where the problem begins. We land In Amsterdam Netherlands with 15 minutes to get to the other side of the airport, we had to quite literally sprint the entirety of the airport with 2 minutes to spare we arrived flustered at our gate to be greeted by two of the KLM staff ignoring us after our multitude of attempts to gain there attention just for her to wait til the closing time to tell us we cannot get on the flight due to us being “late”. Due to the fact i have severe anxiety this sent me into a breakdown and while my fiancé asks her what we need to do next she continued to ignore us until i was quite literally in tears at the desk and after 5 minutes told us where to go (it was only us at the desk). We then spent about half hour walking around schipol airport finding the transfer desk again, being ignored by the staff and eventually being called to the desk told us there was no flights for today as they were all “overbooked” she then put us on a flight for 8PM the next day and told to go to the nearby IBIS hotel and gave a 15$ voucher for the airport (which none of the food places accepted). Upon arriving at the hotel we were greeted by a line to check in that almost reached the door (all let down by KLM) And told we had to check in later else we’d miss our chance to eat, which of course was a problem because the chicken we were given was pink on the inside. We eventually checked in, the only positive to this was the room was nicely kept and we were able to get a nights sleep. Checkout was at noon which meant we had 8hrs to sit in a airport and wait. The boarding of the new flight was so disorganised with many of the passengers looking stressed and the KLM staff per usual chatting amongst themselves and not caring to help solve any problems. The the journey was spent cramped due to KLM being more bothered about profit than overbooking flights. Due to this i will be cancelling my flight back with them and taking my business elsewhere. I will NOT be flying with KLM again and will move to another business.
reviews.author: Megan H

reviews.title: Worse than low-cost
reviews.text: I bought pricy tickets for the sole reason to have a 5 hour pleasent flight instead of buying low-cost. but the number of sits they shove in this plane is unbearable, i am a tiny person and i had no space for my legs and no space to breath, actually worse flight expreince than any low-cost company but the price is 2X. Add to that the fact that it didnt allow me to check -in online + the fact that the Service representative told my brother to just "cancel the ticket and see if it works" and we lost the money completely they just disapeared. actually a horrible experience and would never fly or recommend people flying KLM again.
reviews.author: Arti pichersky

reviews.title: Very good flight, but catering was a potentially major issue for me
reviews.text: Excellent flight, smooth throughout, even in economy. Very good friendly cabin crew - such a change from the budget airlines. All flights on time, luggage reasonably quick, and steady flight with useful updates from the front cabin. The only minus point was the catering, or more specifically the Dutch cheese sandwich, that was handed out, (no choice available), however it contained mustard , to which I am allergic - although nothing on the outer packaging. This could have been a major problem for me, and possibly others. I thinkn that we should be told............
reviews.author: Cherriesfan99

reviews.title: Terrible KLM check-in / boarding service experience
reviews.text: My flight was scheduled for 10.05 pm, drop-off by 8.05 pm at Lagos MM international airport. I got to the counter to drop off my luggage by 8.15 pm having already checked-in online. All KLM check-in team service were either nowhere to be found or pretending that they were part of air France and not attending to KLM passengers or selectively attending to some KLM passengers. Disappointed with this terrible service. Why? Because the flight was eventually delayed by more than 45 minutes and no apologies tendered whatsoever. KLM counter service team seems to take delight in making travel experience miserable and agonising for passengers even before the flight. The same team eventually did the boarding, yet, it was terrible. Now, if you cannot accept my luggage, at least, you should be able to print my boarding pass as there was still plenty of time to do so and board my flight. There was no provision for self-service boarding pass print as you would normally find everywhere else in the world. KLM staff were all standing with mean faces, unhelpful and very aggressive. I think they forgot that if passengers do not travel on their airline, they do not have a job. Even the lead supervisor was called, he was just dodging moving erratically here and there without providing any help. It feels more like the interest is to make sure passengers missed their flights and start lobbying to purchase another ticket through the racketeers. Or missed their luggage and start looking for another flight to pay more. Or both. Something is strange in the way KLM service is provided at this airport. It needs investigating. I was extremely unhappy that I boarded KLM flight without my luggage despite the fact that there was plenty of time plus the flight was delayed by more than 45 minutes.
reviews.author: ElteeA575

reviews.title: Great flight and easy transit as gates together
reviews.text: Comfortable efficient flight with nice snack and drinks served (unlike the likes of BA). Great transit as incoming plane in the same gate area, something KLM often do well. Arrived on time with no issues
reviews.author: Warby

reviews.title: Good flight but a little annoying still messing with buses to move around Schippol
reviews.text: First flight out of Belgrade on the day. Quick boarding with flight 20% full. Good sandwich and couple of drink services. Landed 25 minutes early and got to gate b4 arrival time even thought as bus to terminal
reviews.author: Warby

reviews.title: Frustrating they pad flight times and are still late on short haul
reviews.text: Great lounge in Amsterdam and no need to change gates which is always a bonus. Comfortable seat and flight only half full. Arrived late even though time padded. Nice sandwich as snack
reviews.author: Warby

reviews.title: Good flight and they still serve a half decent snack
reviews.text: Fast track security okay but as always Birmingham airport staff are so slow. Flight departed late but arrived on time. Veggie meal poor but service good. If transiting through Amsterdam you have to go to check in even if no checked bag and already checked in online, strange one!!! Smaller plane so bus to terminal on arrival
reviews.author: Warby
